final: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM race_averages) SELECT r.raceId, r.avg_points, r.avg_wins, r.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS wins_difference FROM race_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wins_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
